Sports Injury Rehabilitation in Nashik

Scientific, home-based rehab for ACL tears, ankle sprains, tennis elbow, and rotator cuff injuries — designed to safely return you to full performance.

Understanding Sports Injury Rehabilitation

Sports injuries such as ACL tears, ankle sprains, tennis elbow, and rotator cuff injuries need a structured rehabilitation approach to restore strength, stability, and confidence before returning to activity. Rushing back too early increases the risk of re-injury, so progression is guided by clinical assessment at every stage.

Dr. Sandesha Sonawane evaluates the injury, current stage of healing, and functional limitations during the first home visit to design a phased recovery plan.

Who May Benefit

  • Athletes recovering from ACL tears or ligament injuries
  • Patients with ankle sprains affecting balance and mobility
  • Tennis elbow or rotator cuff injury cases
  • Anyone wanting a structured, supervised return-to-activity plan

Our Treatment Approach

Rehabilitation is phased to match your injury's healing stage — from initial pain and swelling management to strength rebuilding and, eventually, functional and sport-specific exercises. Every plan follows the same structured process:

  • Clinical Assessment — evaluating the injury, joint stability, and functional limitations
  • Custom Treatment Plan — a phased recovery roadmap matched to your injury and activity goals
  • Interactive Home Visits — hands-on therapy and supervised strengthening/mobility exercises
  • Recovery Monitoring — tracking strength and function before progressing intensity

What to Expect at Home

Sessions run about 45 to 60 minutes, combining hands-on treatment with supervised, progressive exercises. Portable therapeutic equipment is brought to your home as needed. A prescription is helpful but not mandatory to begin.

Frequently Asked Questions

The right time to start physiotherapy depends on the type and severity of the injury. An assessment during the first home visit helps determine the appropriate stage to begin rehabilitation.

Home physiotherapy can support ACL and ligament injury rehabilitation through structured, progressive exercises supervised at each visit. The specific plan depends on whether the injury is managed conservatively or post-surgically.

Home physiotherapy sessions in Nashik cover ACL tears, ankle sprains, tennis elbow, and rotator cuff injuries, along with general sports-related muscle and joint injuries.
